notes.title: English Version officially playable!
notes.notes:
It’s finally here: The game is now also playable in its English version! To do this, simply set the language to English in the game properties on Steam.

Information regarding your game progress: If your save files have disappeared due to recent updates: Navigate to the Light and Shadow folder in your SteamApps directory -> www -> and copy your ‘saves’ folder as a backup, especially since there’s no cloud storage yet. After each update, simply place this folder back into the ‘www’ directory of the game, if you are among those affected!

If any of you have experienced issues with your save files, I apologize! The aforementioned steps should prevent this problem from occurring again!

notes.title: Overview of the next Update
notes.notes:
Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria will receive an English-language version in the next update and will thus leave the German-exclusive version.

In addition, the next update, which will be released after the English version, will have the following new content:

[list]
[*] More lively forest town: The town on the 1st island will be more lively than ever and will have new characters as well as more walk-in options
[*] New story section: There will be more story elements in the game to bring the world to life.
[/list]

Please understand that Light and Shadow - Shadows over Empyria is a 1-developer game and it may take some time for new and innovative content to be added to the game.

The target for the English language update is currently the end of April. Subject to change.

The game is being improved under high pressure and listens to the community. 
In the meantime, if you think of something you would like to see in the game, please let us know! We will consider whether and how we can incorporate the requested content into the game.

Have a nice rest of the weekend!
